class.name: HEGoFetchSurfacesConfig
class.deprecated: Use HEGoAssetNode.get_surface_output() instead. Fetch configs are kept
class.brief_description: Attributes, filters and splits for a surface fetch, saved as a resource.
class.description: only so existing projects can move across, and will be removed. The code API takes the same arguments, shares the same implementation and cache, and can decide what to read at runtime.

members.member: Whether to read the [code]N[/code] attribute into the surface's normals.
Whether to read the [code]Cd[/code] attribute into the surface's vertex colours.
Whether to read the first UV set.
Whether to read the second UV set.
Further attribute names to read from the cook, beyond the toggles above.
Attribute names to filter the primitives on, one per entry of [member filter_attrib_values].
The value each attribute in [member filter_attribs] has to carry for a primitive to be kept.
Attribute names to group the kept primitives by, applied in order, one nesting level each.
